tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Participate in the actual campus or community event, engage with attendees and contribute to the live activity
inputs: Actual campus or community event and participants

tasks.design: Retain actual campus and community event participation as human activity. No {DOCS} record, lookup or digital handoff is established for this participation episode, so no software change is priced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is actual participation and interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: No software mechanism replaces the identified live contribution.
tasks.still_hard: Being present and responding to actual people require the teacher.
tasks.human_edge: Represent the subject and institution through direct participation.

ambition.what: No additional event capacity is claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live event participation requires human presence; a document or calendar tool does not perform that contribution.

assumptions: Representative attendance and contribution at an existing event, not event organization, a prepared lecture or a booth sales workflow. Actual organizers produce the event during their existing work; no saving is claimed for that unchanged work.

Before assigning zero, check actual registration, attendee records, travel claims, preparation materials, follow-up notes and messages. None is established by this participation episode. If any is actually required, split its real record writing, lookup or send from live participation and examine native views, templates or settings before re-estimating; do not fold it into s1 or assume it has no change.

No administrative report, post-event email or recurring event setup is invented. No send, commit, publication, approval or payment is hidden in the live step. This zero cannot be extrapolated to other event duties without observing their actual work.
The share of 100 is a task-episode estimate independent of the prompt prior. All 100 hours remain human; gross and net are 0. No new system, configuration or incremental upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Whether actual event duties include any required record or handoff
research_questions: Observe a real event participation episode and check explicitly for actual record writes, preparation, lookup and follow-up actions.

already_counted.description: All actual live event participation remains in s1.

incremental.description: No new system or changed process is introduced; there is no incremental work.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All identified work is actual live participation. A native document or calendar setting does not replace it; any observed record, lookup or follow-up action must be separately assessed before retaining this zero.
